description.value: A-FRAME Brewing Co. is an award-winning craft brewery and tasting room in Squamish, BC, celebrated for its relaxed 'cabin vibes' atmosphere—an outdoor patio with a fire pit, mountain backdrop, and an inclusive, welcoming community ethos. The brewery names its beers after BC lakes and earned Gold and Silver at the 2023 Canadian Brewing Awards. Cyclists will find a natural post-ride stop with growler fills, cold packaged cans to go, and regular on-site food truck service.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: wave (7 spaces) at 12m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active craft brewery tasting room in Squamish. The FAQ explicitly references 'aprés ride' snacks, indicating cycling clientele awareness; on-site washrooms are confirmed for patrons ('use of our washrooms and seating is for our patrons only'); Flipside Burgers food truck explicitly offers vegetarian, vegan, and GF options; and growler fills plus packaged cans confirm takeout. No bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging are mentioned anywhere on the site. The website address adds unit '#1' and postal code not present in OSM, flagged as a discrepancy.
concerns: OSM address '38927 Queens Way' omits the unit number; website consistently shows '1-38927 Queens Way, Squamish, BC V8B 0K9'. Website address used as primary; contact_confirmed.address set to false.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established craft brewery and tasting room in Squamish, a major BC cycling hub. Cycling-aware (FAQ references 'aprés ride' snacks), with on-site washrooms, takeout options, and dietary-inclusive food truck—a strong fit for touring cyclists.

Washrooms.detail: Website FAQ confirms on-site washrooms for patrons: 'use of our washrooms and seating is for our patrons only.'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Flipside Burgers food truck, parked on-site regularly, offers 'ethical meats, vegetarian and vegan options as well as Gluten Free' burgers per the FAQ
